verdict.rationale: Puzzle is a hosted accounting SaaS. An open-source license is a fair question for this kind of product, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows its source code is published under an open license. The unauthenticated OpenAPI spec and the public API reference document interfaces, not source code, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
